vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Collect assigned ventilation readings and maintain traceable instrument, unit and location references.
requirements.zh: 采集分配的通风读数，并维护可追溯仪器、单位及位置编号。

requirements.en: Check records and refer inaccessible points or reference discrepancies to the commissioning engineer.
requirements.zh: 检查记录，并将无法到达测点或编号差异转交调试工程师。

requirements.en: Maintain clear measurement handovers and preserve engineer approval boundaries.
requirements.zh: 维护清晰测量交接，并遵守工程师审批权限边界。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently approve complete ventilation-system performance.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立批准完整通风系统的性能。
